name: mdx-pages-trust-state-contract
human_line: No page is trusted by silence. Trust is computed from what is known - source, owner, lifecycle, evidence - and what would make a page more trustworthy is named out loud.

dimensions.source_known: the body is served from a recorded source reference, never a copy
dimensions.owner: the first recorded actor in the page's chain, or the declared author for charter pages

trusted_for_ai.rule: published AND source_known AND a named owner
trusted_for_ai.consumers: the agent citation policy (P8) reads this flag - Twin cites only pages that carry it
trusted_for_ai.never: an unreviewed draft becoming an agent's ground truth

more_trustworthy_with: every page below the bar lists exactly what is missing - a published revision, a named owner, evidence worth citing
freshness: review cadence and staleness land with the ownership slice (P4) and extend this contract
